## Highlights
### New
- Choose how much room the sidebar keeps between tabs, the address field, pins and section headers with Spacing in Settings › Appearance: None, Tight, Default or Relaxed. It appears in every customization style.
### Improved
- Tab size in Settings › Appearance is now a slider with nine steps, from Thin to Large, and a thin tab keeps its title readable while losing the room around it. The Space header grows and shrinks with your tabs. - On Mac, the sidebar slides in and out a third faster by default. Choose its speed in Settings › Appearance › Sidebar slide time.
---

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
